title: Data-bound blocks still title their "data source could not be resolved" panel in English: 16 plugin errorTitle literals and the two @object-ui/react panel defaults (the family after objectui#12910)
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with named producers, from the os-dev report on objectui#12910 (PR #12919, out-of-scope finding, class a). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What

objectui#12910 (PR #12919) makes `element:number` and `element:record_picker` title their unresolvable-view panel from the bundle (`element.number.sourceUnresolved`, `element.recordPicker.sourceUnresolved`). Every other data-bound block still passes an English literal as the panel title. Read on objectui `main` `7bee002`:

- `plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx:284`, `plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:1738`;
- `plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:242` (metric) and `:400` (pivot table);
- `plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:268`, `plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx:755`;
- `plugin-form/src/index.tsx:222`, `:432`, `:519` and `:670` (line items);
- `plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx:108`, `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx:156`, `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:517`, `plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx:303` (pinned in English by `ListView.sharedGate.test.tsx:142`), `plugin-map/src/index.tsx:55`, `plugin-timeline/src/index.tsx:350`.

Each reads "This X’s data source could not be resolved". The panel's own defaults in `packages/react/src/element-data-source/ElementDataSourceGate.tsx` are English too: `:531` "This component’s data source could not be resolved" and `:743` "No data source resolved".

**reach:** a public door. Any of these blocks whose `dataSource.view` names no view, rendered on a zh-CN (or any non-English) page, draws the English title above the resolver's message. The two `renderers/basic` blocks draw the viewer's language after PR #12919, so the same page mixes languages by block. Read from source; not measured in a browser. The panel's message body (the view resolver's error) was not read.

## Expected

Each title reads the bundle, one key per block kind in the shape PR #12919 used (`element.KIND.sourceUnresolved`, or the plugin's own block if it has one), in all ten packs, with the `@object-ui/react` defaults reading it too. A pin per family renders the zh-CN title, and the English pin in `ListView.sharedGate.test.tsx` is edited deliberately.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage, then `domain:ui`. The first landings are the 16 call sites above and `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`.

**Dedupe** (open and closed): objectui issues searched for "data source could not be resolved errorTitle English zh ElementDataSourceErrorPanel plugin i18n panel title" (5 hits: objectui#11160, #11145, #8889, #3134, #1130, all closed, none naming these titles) and for "ElementDataSourceGate No data source resolved English default panel title view names nothing" (0 hits). The open `area:i18n` cards are objectui#12910 (this finding's source, which fixes the two in `renderers/basic` only) and #12899 (a kanban lane label).

Dedupe words: data source could not be resolved, errorTitle English zh, ElementDataSourceErrorPanel title, sourceUnresolved, No data source resolved.
